## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

List the exact tests, builds, evaluation sets, and metrics used. For ranking
changes, include the comparison baseline and avoid claims based on private or
undisclosed data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation and configuration examples where needed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private catalogs, profiles, or sensitive traces.
- [ ] Online-provider tests use fakes and do not spend API credits in CI.
- [ ] I described any compatibility, latency, cost, or ranking-quality tradeoff.
